messages:
Maya: heads up - deploy-bot just paused the canary promotion for release v1.9.2. checksum mismatch reported for artifacts uploaded to eu-west.

deploy-bot: promotion stalled: artifact verification failed for package redwood-inference-1.9.2.tar.gz (expected 9f2a, got 0000). source: signing-service eu-west returned 503 during verification. auto-retry exhausted.

Sam: any chance the upload was corrupted on our side? CI finished green earlier.

Aisha: I replicated a quick curl against signing-service and saw intermittent 503s. snippet: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://signing.internal/eu-west/verify/9f2a` -> 503

Olivia: if signing fails we can't safely promote, per compliance. Can we reupload to a different bucket/region and re-trigger verification?

Maya: thoughts on rollback vs reupload? Canary is only 2% traffic, but promotion will block the full release.

Frank: strongly prefer not to rollback if we can avoid it. Rolling back the canary will complicate metrics and last-mile QA. Reupload + reverify seems cleaner.

Sam: I can rebuild artifact and push to staging-bucket-eu and trigger the deploybot verify hook. ETA ~20m.

Jordan: I'll open a ticket for signing-service with logs and bump its retry/backoff. tagging infra oncall. ticket: SVC-1482.

deploy-bot: manual action required -> set `deploybot/allow-manual-verify` if you want to force verify against alternate location.

Aisha: quick safety check: if we push an identical tar with new upload id, checksum will match original if content same. but signing-service might return a different signature blob. we should keep original artifact name and just reattempt verification to minimize churn.

Sam: re-upload complete to staging-bucket-eu: `gs://staging-bucket-eu/redwood-inference-1.9.2.tar.gz` and triggered `POST /internal/deploy/verify` with upload_id=eu-20260320-01.

deploy-bot: verify attempt 1 -> 503. retrying... verify attempt 2 -> 200, checksum ok. Promotion can proceed but needs manual approval due to the transient failure.

Olivia: I'll hold on auto-promotion and update release notes + change window: shifting main promotion + announcement by 1 hour to allow for monitoring.

Maya: decision: do not rollback. manual approval to continue once we confirm canary healthy for 30m. Sam/Aisha to watch metrics. Jordan to follow up on SVC-1482. Olivia will update notes and notify CS.

Frank: adding note - don't enable any bypass (no skipping signing) until infra confirms fix.

Sam: watching logs now. thumbs up from me is fine after 30m if no regressions. :thumbsup:

Olivia: updated release notes and posted change-window msg to #general. I'll prep the customer-facing blurb in case it needs to be pushed.

Maya: thanks team. leaving thread open for 30m for canary check, will close after successful promotion or if rollback becomes necessary.
